title: Show HN: RxFilm Studio–Create and edit your product videos with AI agent
summary: RxFilm Studio is an AI-powered video workspace that enables independent developers and small teams to create and edit product marketing videos using AI agents, streamlining the traditionally time-consuming video production process.
problem_solved: Reduces the time and effort required to produce professional marketing videos for products without requiring video production expertise.
why_valuable: Democratizes video creation by automating editing, visual effects, voiceovers, and subtitles for small teams with limited resources.
